records.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production transparent game sprite atlas. Input image 1 is the exact Fufu player identity and eight facing directions; input image 2 is only a reference for the game's armor rendering quality. Create Fufu wearing a NEW Greek Olympus-inspired CELESTIAL armor set. Keep the creamy soybean/bean silhouette, adorable black eyes, cheek blush, tiny limbs and TWO GREEN SPROUT LEAVES (not a tofu cube, not a human). Outfit: pearl ivory open-face winged helmet with gold laurel trim leaving sprout visible, ivory breastplate with gold Greek-key trim and small sky-blue star gem, ivory pteruges skirt and golden leg guards, matching ivory winged boots, short pale lavender mantle with blue lining, small ivory gloves. Gold and pearl, pastel blue glow, restrained fine detail, thick dark friendly cartoon ink, cel-shaded polished hand-painted art. Single character, identical equipment in EVERY view. EXACTLY eight full-body idle sprites in a regular FOUR columns by TWO rows atlas. Top row left to right: SOUTH/front, SOUTHWEST/front-left three-quarter, WEST/left profile, NORTHWEST/back-left three-quarter. Bottom row: NORTH/back, NORTHEAST/back-right three-quarter, EAST/right profile, SOUTHEAST/front-right three-quarter. Each character fully visible inside its equal cell, same scale and sole baseline, generous transparent gutters. Hands empty and relaxed at waist, no held weapons. Consistent anatomy and sprout orientation, true separately authored left and right views. No text, labels, captions, grid, frame, background, ground plane or cast shadows. Genuine alpha transparency outside the sprites. Wide atlas, 2:1 aspect.
